checks: A name edit updates the correct ID and its results while preserving login, password, key and dates
A retry after a partial name write reconciles results and creates a single audit entry
Stale names and cadet access cannot overwrite another instructor change
The primary instructor can edit staff names while their title and role remain intact
Choice corrections recalculate the existing result and retain the immutable submission identity
Changing a written answer invalidates only that answer grade and retains the original
Another active review lease blocks corrections before any snapshot is written
Stale revisions, missing reasons and unknown answer IDs cannot mutate accepted work
A lost canonical-write acknowledgement retries one correction and one journal entry
A snapshot-write failure leaves the result untouched and the same request can succeed later
Corrupted original snapshots block further edits without replacing current answers
Written grading after an answer correction preserves the correction chain
Deleting one result purges only its private answer history
Large Unicode answer originals survive chunk boundaries and are archived before intake cleanup
Cadet name dialog changes the selected ID and leaves login intact
Staff name controls are available to the primary instructor
Correction editor shows escaped original text and enforces two selected choices
Unsaved corrections survive reload and remain in this account
A disk-write failure retains the draft and prevents any correction RPC
Lost acknowledgement freezes the request; retry updates the same attempt once
Primary answers remain visible after correction and narrow layout fits
Stale work is rejected and reloading keeps the previous local draft for comparison
Cadet sees recalculated work without correction controls or private reasons

checks.name: A cadet without submissions keeps one existing public row and receives the corrected name
A failed cadet-publication marker cannot leave the acknowledged retry with an old public name
A lost account-name acknowledgement retains publication and retry does not duplicate the cadet
A failed publication marker retries the existing result without losing its public name update
A failed result-name acknowledgement retries the existing result without losing its public name update
Manual table repair updates a stale placeholder by ID without changing a namesake or creating an attempt
Name publication preserves manual columns and does not reinterpret unidentified historical work as a placeholder
A queued cold read rechecks readiness after the first initializer finishes under the shared lock
Explicit maintenance still repairs headers even when readiness is already cached
Failure during schema repair cannot mark a partial initialization as ready
